scene: The pigeon coos mechanical routes across the city.
picture: Pixel art flat side-view along the clocktower catwalk. On the far left stands a blue ferryboat ticket machine. In the centre, the young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella listens to the brass pigeon. To the right waits a dangling red cable car, and far right an illuminated subway hatch.
shown: a blue ferryboat ticket machine glowing brightly on the far left
a dangling red cable car waiting open on the catwalk railing right
an illuminated subway hatch and iron ladder down on the far right
